next.name: GOLD LOCUST
next.headline: GOLD LOCUST: a tracked group tied to the Carbanak backdoor, with a hedged link to Sodinokibi attacks
next.in_short: Secureworks tracks GOLD LOCUST, also called Carbanak and FIN7. IBM X-Force reported a Carbanak backdoor tied to a Sodinokibi ransomware attack. It says the link to its ITG14 group rests on tool similarity.

sentences.t: Secureworks tracks this actor as GOLD LOCUST.
Other names for it are Anunak, Carbanak, Carbon Spider, FIN7 and Silicon.
The catalogue lists Carbanak as its tool.
IBM Security X-Force describes investigating a Carbanak backdoor associated with a Sodinokibi ransomware attack.
IBM X-Force concludes that ITG14 is at least one affiliate group that contracts with Sodinokibi ransomware-as-a-service providers.
The report's Carbanak link rests on similarity to ITG14 tools, so it is an inference and not a flat statement of identity.
Defenders can keep offline backups, require multifactor authentication on remote access, and patch known flaws promptly.
